en.title: The End of the World, Magic, and Scientific Love
en.premise: Prince Artler and the silver-haired, blue-eyed noblewoman Luna were bound by a political marriage. As she stood by his side as an elegant queen, Luna truly loved him. However, mysterious incidents involving ancient ruins begin to plague the kingdom. And at the heart of it all lies Luna herself—a woman who has lost her memories.
